source: mangadex.org public API, top works by follower count
note: Positives are titles MangaDex records for the SAME work, split by how close the two strings are: near_variant (identical once punctuation, spacing and diacritics are stripped - exactly what title normalisation is responsible for), distinct_rendering (a different translation of the same work - unreachable from title text alone, needs external ids or cover hashing), and cross_script. Negatives are DIFFERENT works sharing an author or tag - the hard cases; random pairs would flatter any matcher. excluded_negatives are pairs MangaDex lists separately but our policy deliberately merges (edition variants, PLAN.md 2.5) - kept for visibility, out of the metric.
